stories.headline: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber rated 'critical' — it built 948 working Linux root exploits
stories.summary: OpenAI says its security model found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws and validated 948 Linux privilege-escalation exploits in ~30 hours.

stories.headline: Xbox PC app redesign: up to 60% faster, out for Insiders now
stories.summary: Home, Store and Game Pass pages load up to 50% faster; the web cloud-gaming Library gets the same treatment. Everyone else waits for the wider rollout.

stories.headline: Free Play Days: PAYDAY 3, Anno 117, Call of Duty MW4 DMZ free this weekend
stories.summary: PAYDAY 3, BALL x PIT, Deceive Inc and more free for Game Pass members through Sunday Nov 8; DMZ free for everyone Nov 6–11.

stories.headline: Game Pass Wave 1: Warhammer Survivors lands Nov 10
stories.summary: Football Manager 27 Console and Warhammer Survivors headline the Nov 9–13 wave; 13 titles leave Nov 15, including GoldenEye 007 and Wreckfest.

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Uruguay, starting 12-day Latin America tour
stories.summary: Three weeks after lung-cancer surgery, the pope begins a 12-day, three-nation tour (Uruguay, Argentina, Peru) — 36 speeches, a stop in Cusco above 11,000 feet.

stories.headline: Trump names Stephen Miller chief of staff; new minor strikes on Iran
stories.summary: Miller takes over Monday Nov 9; Trump confirmed a strike on an anti-aircraft system on Qeshm Island, the first since the election.

stories.headline: Netflix orders Stranger Things prequel 'Other Worlds' for 2028
stories.summary: Set April 19, 1955 in Marion, Nevada — before Hawkins, before the stage play — from the Duffers and Kate Trefry, with Joe Wright directing the first episodes.
